clientCount.description: The number of guests at the table.

openDate.description: The date this account was opened in UTC.

closeDate.description: The date this account was closed in UTC.

paidAmount.description: The total of all payments on the check.

serviceCharge.description: The service charge applied to the check.

currentAmount.description: The current total amount on the check.

staffName.description: The name of the staff member assigned to the check.

staffId.description: The unique ID of the staff member assigned to the check.

paymentEntries.description: Collection of payment entries to the check.

ikaccountId.description: The system-generated account identifier for this check.(Applies to iKentoo V3+).

tableNumber.description: The table number assigned to the check.

posId.description: The unique ID of the POS station that processed the check.

id.description: The unique ID assigned to the sale line.

uuid.description: The UUID assigned to the sale line.

itemName.description: The name given to the item.

itemSku.description: The SKU assigned to the item.

quantity.description: The quantity of the item for this sale line.

modifiers.description: The modifiers of the item for this sale line.

amountWithTax.description: The total price of the item including tax.

amountLessTax.description: The total price of the item without tax.

discountedAmount.description: The amount the item was discounted.

timeOfTransactionUtc.description: The date and time in UTC when the transaction occurred.

subLineItems.description: Collection of sub-line items associated with this sale line.

taxIncluded.description: Indicates whether tax is included in the unit amount.

paymentMethodDescription.description: Payment method for this payment line.

paymentMethodCode.description: Payment method code for this payment line.

amountPaid.description: Amount paid for this payment line.

paymentDate.description: Date/Time in UTC of this payment.

active.description: Whether this payment line is active or not.

apeModifier.description: The modifiers of the item for this sale line
